The solid red polygon P is the pre-image. The green polygon is its image after one transformation applied to P.
Which of these was applied? Reply with the letter only.
A) translated
B) reflected
C) rotated
B

The solid red polygon P is the pre-image. The green polygon is its image after two transformations, in order, applied to P.
Which of these was applied? Reply with the letter only.
A) translated, then reflected
B) translated, then translated
C) reflected, then translated
D) translated, then rotated
D

The solid red polygon P is the pre-image. The green polygon is its image after two transformations, in order, applied to P.
Which of these was applied? Reply with the letter only.
A) translated, then reflected
B) rotated, then translated
C) translated, then rotated
D) reflected, then reflected
A
